newsitem.title: USA: N.Y. Power Authority hearings on open access plan.
newsitem.headline: N.Y. Power Authority hearings on open access plan.

text.p: The New York Power Authority said Friday it would hold two public meetings next week to seek comments on a possible plan to outline its proposals and rates for open access to transmission lines.

The meetings will be at 1000 EDT/1400 GMT Wednesday at the authority's Clark Energy Center on Glass Factory Road in Marcy, near Utica, N.Y., and at 1000 EDT/1400 GMT Friday at the authority's offices at 1633 Broadway in New York City.

The Federal Energy Regulatory Commission has directed utilities to open their transmission lines to competing electricity suppliers to promote competition, boost efficiency and reduce costs for consumers.

In particular, the Power Authority said, it was seeking comments on whether it should revise its present transmission rate plan; on how changes in transmission service might affect its customers; and on how changes might improve competition in New York state.
